quests.instruction: You notice a wrapped box in the closet with your name on it. How do you feel?
quests.question: Curious
quests.hint: Seeing something mysterious meant just for you makes you want to know more.
quests.explanation: Seeing something mysterious meant just for you makes you want to peek and learn more.
quests.funFact: The wondering feeling before a gift is opened is part of what makes gifts so fun!

quests.instruction: You make funny faces in the mirror until you cannot stop giggling. How do you feel?
quests.question: Silly
quests.hint: Making goofy faces just to entertain yourself brings on the giggles fast.
quests.explanation: Making goofy faces just for fun is a playful little moment of giggly joy.
quests.funFact: Making faces uses lots of the tiny muscles in your face — it is like a workout and a joke at once!

quests.instruction: You rock gently in a hammock on a warm afternoon. How do you feel?
quests.question: Calm
quests.hint: Slow, gentle rocking can make your whole body feel loose and settled.
quests.explanation: Slow, gentle rocking helps your whole body feel loose, settled, and relaxed.
quests.funFact: Gentle rocking motions can help both babies and grown-ups feel more relaxed!

quests.instruction: Your mom is a few minutes late picking you up from school. How do you feel?
quests.question: Worried
quests.hint: Waiting for someone who is running late can make your mind wonder why.
quests.explanation: Waiting for someone who is running a little late can give you a small, uneasy feeling.
quests.funFact: Grown-ups get held up sometimes by traffic or a long line — it usually is not anything serious.

quests.instruction: You move to a new town and have not made any friends yet. How do you feel?
quests.question: Lonely
quests.hint: Being somewhere new with no familiar faces yet can feel quiet and empty.
quests.explanation: Being somewhere new without any familiar faces yet can leave you with a quiet, empty feeling.
quests.funFact: Joining a class club or team is a great way to meet new friends faster!

quests.instruction: You see a caterpillar and wonder what it will turn into. How do you feel?
quests.question: Curious
quests.hint: Watching a small creature that is about to change makes you want to keep watching.
quests.explanation: Watching a small creature that is about to change makes you want to learn what happens next.
quests.funFact: A caterpillar can turn into a butterfly in as little as ten days!

quests.instruction: You put your shirt on backwards and do not notice all morning. How do you feel once you realize it?
quests.question: Silly
quests.hint: Realizing you did something a little goofy can make you giggle at yourself.
quests.explanation: Realizing you did something a little goofy, like a backwards shirt, is a fun, giggly moment.
quests.funFact: Laughing at small mistakes is a healthy way to shake them off quickly!

quests.instruction: You sip warm cocoa quietly by the fireplace. How do you feel?
quests.question: Calm
quests.hint: A warm drink in a cozy, quiet spot can help your whole body settle down.
quests.explanation: A warm drink in a cozy, quiet spot helps your whole body feel settled and content.
quests.funFact: Warm drinks can help your body feel relaxed, especially on a chilly evening!

quests.instruction: You are waiting to find out if your artwork was picked for the school art show. How do you feel?
quests.question: Worried
quests.hint: Waiting to hear news about something you worked hard on can give you a fluttery feeling.
quests.explanation: Waiting to hear news about something you worked hard on can give you an uneasy, fluttery feeling.
quests.funFact: No matter the answer, finishing and sharing your art is already something to feel good about!

quests.instruction: Your older siblings are busy and will not let you join their game. How do you feel?
quests.question: Lonely
quests.hint: Being left out of a game the people you look up to are sharing can feel quiet and empty.
quests.explanation: Being left out of a game your siblings are sharing can leave you with a quiet, empty feeling.
quests.funFact: Starting your own fun game nearby can sometimes turn into an invitation to join in!

quests.instruction: You find a locked box tucked away in the attic. How do you feel?
quests.question: Curious
quests.hint: Discovering something hidden and locked away makes you want to know what is inside.
quests.explanation: Discovering something hidden and locked away makes you want to know exactly what is inside.
quests.funFact: Attics are popular places to find old, forgotten treasures in many homes!

quests.instruction: You wear a colander on your head as a hat and march around the house. How do you feel?
quests.question: Silly
quests.hint: Turning a kitchen tool into a goofy costume piece is a very playful idea.
quests.explanation: Turning a kitchen tool into a goofy hat and marching around is playful, giggly fun.
quests.funFact: Playing pretend with everyday objects is a great way to use your imagination!

quests.instruction: You sit in the garden listening to birds chirp softly. How do you feel?
quests.question: Calm
quests.hint: Sitting still and listening to soft, gentle sounds can help you feel settled.
quests.explanation: Sitting still and listening to soft, gentle sounds helps your whole body feel settled.
quests.funFact: Listening to birdsong is known to help many people's minds feel more relaxed!

quests.instruction: You are about to try out for the school play for the very first time. How do you feel?
quests.question: Worried
quests.hint: Doing something new and important for the first time can make your tummy feel fluttery.
quests.explanation: Trying something new and important for the first time can give you a fluttery, uneasy feeling.
quests.funFact: Practicing your lines out loud a few times can help this fluttery feeling shrink.

quests.instruction: You are new to the team and do not know anyone's name yet. How do you feel?
quests.question: Lonely
quests.hint: Standing with a group where you do not know anyone yet can feel quiet and empty.
quests.explanation: Standing with a group where you do not know anyone yet can leave you with a quiet, empty feeling.
quests.funFact: Learning just one teammate's name is often the first step to feeling like part of the group!

quests.instruction: Your teacher starts a science experiment with bubbling, colorful liquid. How do you feel?
quests.question: Curious
quests.hint: Watching something unusual happen right in front of you makes you lean in for a closer look.
quests.explanation: Watching something unusual happen makes you want to lean in and find out how it works.
quests.funFact: Bubbling colors in science experiments usually happen because of a fun chemical reaction!

quests.instruction: You talk in a squeaky voice to make your little sister laugh. How do you feel?
quests.question: Silly
quests.hint: Making funny voices on purpose to get a laugh feels playful and light.
quests.explanation: Making a funny voice on purpose to get a laugh is a playful, silly kind of fun.
quests.funFact: Laughter is contagious — one giggle often leads to a whole room laughing!

quests.instruction: You color slowly and carefully in your favorite coloring book. How do you feel?
quests.question: Calm
quests.hint: Slow, careful coloring with no rush can help your mind settle down.
quests.explanation: Slow, careful coloring with no rush can help your mind feel settled and quiet.
quests.funFact: Coloring slowly is a favorite relaxing activity for kids and grown-ups alike!

quests.instruction: Your little brother wanders a little too far ahead of you at the park. How do you feel?
quests.question: Worried
quests.hint: Keeping an eye on someone smaller who has wandered off can make your chest feel tight.
quests.explanation: Watching someone smaller wander a little too far away can give you an uneasy, watchful feeling.
quests.funFact: Calling their name calmly and walking toward them is a great way to help this feeling pass.

quests.instruction: Your best friend is out sick and you eat lunch by yourself. How do you feel?
quests.question: Lonely
quests.hint: Missing your usual lunch buddy can make the table feel extra quiet.
quests.explanation: Missing your usual lunch buddy can leave you with a quiet, empty feeling at the table.
quests.funFact: Sitting with a new classmate for one lunch can turn into an unexpected new friendship!

quests.instruction: You find an old key and do not know which door it opens. How do you feel?
quests.question: Curious
quests.hint: Holding a mystery object with an unknown answer makes you want to explore.
quests.explanation: Holding a mysterious object with an unknown answer makes you want to explore and find out more.
quests.funFact: Old keys can be fun clues in a real-life mystery — try matching it to different locks!

quests.instruction: You tell a joke so goofy that even you cannot stop laughing at it. How do you feel?
quests.question: Silly
quests.hint: Cracking yourself up with your own joke is a fun, giggly moment.
quests.explanation: Making even yourself laugh with a goofy joke is a fun, playful, giggly moment.
quests.funFact: Sharing a joke that makes everyone laugh together is a great way to feel close to friends!

quests.instruction: You float quietly on your back in the pool. How do you feel?
quests.question: Calm
quests.hint: Floating gently with your ears in the water can help everything feel slow and quiet.
quests.explanation: Floating gently in the water can help your whole body feel slow, light, and settled.
quests.funFact: Floating on your back is one of the easiest, most relaxing ways to rest in water!

quests.instruction: Your plant has not grown at all this week. How do you feel?
quests.question: Worried
quests.hint: Watching over something you are taking care of, hoping it grows well, can feel uneasy.
quests.explanation: Caring for something and hoping it grows well can give you a small, uneasy feeling when it seems slow.
quests.funFact: Plants often grow in little bursts — a slow week does not mean anything is wrong!

quests.instruction: Everyone at recess already has a partner except you. How do you feel?
quests.question: Lonely
quests.hint: Watching everyone else paired up while you are the only one left can feel quiet.
quests.explanation: Watching everyone else paired up while you are left out can leave you with a quiet, empty feeling.
quests.funFact: Asking 'can I join you?' is a brave, simple way to turn this feeling around.

quests.instruction: You find a strange, colorful bug you have never seen before. How do you feel?
quests.question: Curious
quests.hint: Spotting something new and unfamiliar can make you want to look closer.
quests.explanation: Spotting something new and unfamiliar makes you want to look closer and learn more about it.
quests.funFact: Scientists discover new kinds of insects every single year!

quests.instruction: You make up a funny new dance with your friends in the backyard. How do you feel?
quests.question: Silly
quests.hint: Making up wiggly, funny moves with friends is a very giggly activity.
quests.explanation: Making up funny, wiggly dance moves with friends is a playful, giggly kind of fun.
quests.funFact: Making up your own dance moves is a fun way to be creative with your whole body!

quests.instruction: You take slow breaths while listening to soft music before bed. How do you feel?
quests.question: Calm
quests.hint: Slow breathing and quiet music can make your whole body feel settled.
quests.explanation: Slow breathing and gentle music help your whole body feel settled and peaceful.
quests.funFact: Slow breathing sends a signal to your body that it is safe to relax!

quests.instruction: The sky turns dark and cloudy right before your outdoor picnic. How do you feel?
quests.question: Worried
quests.hint: Watching plans possibly change because of the weather can make you check the sky again and again.
quests.explanation: Watching the weather change right before a planned event can give you an uneasy feeling.
quests.funFact: Packing a small indoor backup plan can help this uneasy feeling feel smaller.

quests.instruction: All of your friends go on a trip that you could not join. How do you feel?
quests.question: Lonely
quests.hint: Being left out of something your friends are sharing together can feel quiet and empty.
quests.explanation: Being left out of something your friends are sharing can leave you with a quiet, empty feeling.
quests.funFact: Asking a friend to video call and tell you about their trip can help this feeling fade.
